gate.bootstrap_plan.description: Plan review gate for self-bootstrap evidence.

failureGuidance.summary: Plan evidence is missing or does not cover the requested target-skill changes.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Read the cited plan-mode rule, refresh the per-run output-root plan/skill-plan.md and the review plan, and record package-index evidence before retrying this gate.

evidenceReferences.quote: Enter plan mode before editing target-skill deliverables.

gate.bootstrap_runtime_ready.description: Shared entry gate part 1 that proves the selected published SO runtime bundle is reacquired, validated, and ready before any downstream route work starts.

failureGuidance.summary: Published runtime, startup-contract, dependency-closure, or resolved-version evidence is missing.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Reacquire the exact locked published SO bundle, verify so.dll, so.deps.json, so.runtimeconfig.json and dependency closure, then record runtime_preflight_result before retrying.

gate.bootstrap_runtime_guide.description: Shared entry gate part 2 that proves the selected published SO runtime is runnable and has produced a fresh guide result before any downstream planning, authoring, validation, compile, run, resume, or input collection work.

failureGuidance.summary: The selected runtime did not produce a fresh readable guide result.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Run bare dotnet so.dll --guide from the verified unified runtime, parse version/docs_root/guide_path, read guide_path, and preserve the fresh guide evidence before retrying.

evidenceReferences.quote: Every enhancement pass must first prove that the skill-bound published Loom Skill Orchestrator runtime is runnable

gate.bootstrap_reenhancement_strategy.description: Re-enhancement strategy gate. A fresh comparison must choose whether the next template pass is a local patch, a structural refactor, or a full regeneration.

failureGuidance.summary: The re-enhancement review did not produce one valid template-change strategy with supporting evidence.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Run the strategy review again with the three gap reports, the old template, the current requirements and concept documents, and the fresh guide. Return exactly local_patch, structural_refactor, or full_regeneration with relative evidence references before continuing.

evidenceReferences.quote: Read the current re-enhancement strategy policy from `contract.json`, `reference/so-skill-reference.md`, and the workflow context. Use the exact machine-readable strategy values required by those authorities and do not invent another value.

gate.bootstrap_compile_review.description: Compile review gate for the self-bootstrap template audit artifacts.

failureGuidance.summary: Compile artifacts or the workflow designer's gate self-review are missing, stale, or inconsistent with the template authority.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Dispatch the local workflow designer with relative-link context, repair the checked-in template, rerun dotnet so.dll compile, and return gate_failure_guidance_review with fresh Mermaid, HTML, and analysis artifacts.

evidenceReferences.quote: Run `dotnet so.dll compile` against that exact external copy

gate.bootstrap_official_blocked.description: Blocked strongest-earned governance gate for the official runnable route.
gate.bootstrap_official_blocked.passExpression: context.Has("workflow_runtime_copy_json") && context.Has("event_log_file") && context.Has("workflow_mermaid_md") && context.Has("workflow_html") && context.Has("workflow_analysis_json") && context.Has("workflow_dataflow_json")

failureGuidance.summary: The blocked route lacks the strongest-earned runtime-owned business evidence or its audit trail.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Inspect the cited blocked-route contract, restore the missing evidence on the same external workflow copy, and resume only after blocked-output families and audit references are present.

evidenceReferences.quote: If `run` returns a runtime-owned block, pass that boundary check and continue with `dotnet so.dll resume`

gate.bootstrap_official_done.description: Done gate for the official runnable route. Final completion must be summarized through a runtime-owned completion manifest that carries the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist for the existing runtime evidence families without self-certifying missing route-proof evidence inside the terminal step.
gate.bootstrap_official_done.passExpression: context.Has("workflow_runtime_copy_json") && context.Has("event_log_file") && context.Has("review_fix_loop_evidence") && context.Has("commit_report_ready") && context.Has("skill_plan_md") && context.Has("governance_notes_md") && context.Has("checked_in_skill_markdown_asset") && context.Has("checked_in_package_lock_asset") && context.Has("node_to_file_map") && context.Has("completion_manifest_reference") && context.Has("completion_manifest_md") && context.Has("workflow_dataflow_json")

failureGuidance.summary: Final Done evidence, target-deliverable changes, review-fix evidence, or the mapped completion manifest is missing.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Do not claim completion. Continue the same dotnet so.dll run/resume chain, run the review-fix loop, modify the requested checked-in deliverables, and regenerate the manifest with explicit evidence mappings.

evidenceReferences.quote: Every later `dotnet so.dll resume` must reference the same persisted instance and state

parameters.expressionContractFragment: ExpressionDefinition { kind, source, entryPoint, resultType }; synchronous C# only; use context.Get<T>("path") for read-only workflow context.
parameters.skillHint: Run the local workflow designer subagent at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md. Pass only the entry document and necessary workflow or contract files as relative-link context. Consume the runtime-owned reenhancement_template_change_strategy and reenhancement_template_change_evidence. For structural_refactor or full_regeneration, treat the old checked-in template as a baseline input and generate a new candidate from current requirements, concept documents, target-skill assets, and the fresh guide; do not force the old topology to survive a conflict. For local_patch, preserve the validated topology and change only non-structural content. When the boundary weaves back, return the refreshed workflow template path, a workflow-designer dispatch record, and a compact evidence_references manifest. Every manifest item must contain a verified 1-based inclusive start_line and end_line. If a guide controls the decision, cite the actual successful guide.<packageversion>.md output file and its output line numbers; do not cite only the guide source or list the entire context pack.

transition.finalize_lock.description: Publish an external completion manifest after the official runnable route has produced enough runtime-owned evidence. This step references checked-in source deliverables, summarizes the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist, and does not claim to recreate the checked-in files.

parameters.content:
# Governance Verdict
- Verdict rule: this manifest summarizes governed completion only when the mapped runtime-owned evidence families below already exist on the official runnable route; it does not create replacement route-proof evidence inside this terminal step.
- Current status: completed on the terminal official runnable route that emitted this manifest.
- Current node: state.done
- Final Done reached: yes on the route that emitted this manifest.
- Missing evidence rule: any null or missing mapped evidence family below must be reported as missing evidence and blocks a compliant interpretation outside this manifest.
- Next action: use commit_report_ready and this runtime-owned completion manifest for final handoff.

# Evidence Checklist
- workflow_runtime_copy_json: runtime-owned workflow copy for the official run chain.
- event_log_file: runtime-owned event log for the same chain.
- review_fix_loop_evidence: prerequisite review and fix lineage for this slice.
- commit_report_ready: completion-time handoff readiness evidence.
- checked_in_skill_markdown_asset: SKILL.md remains the authoritative checked-in source deliverable.
- checked_in_package_lock_asset: assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json remains the authoritative checked-in runtime lock.
- node_to_file_map: assets/so-workflow/node-to-file-map.md remains the authoritative node-to-artifact map.
- completion_manifest_reference: this runtime-owned manifest reference anchors the final verdict surface.
- completion_manifest_md: this human-reviewable manifest is the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist surface.

This manifest summarizes governed completion from the existing runtime-owned evidence families. It does not replace those evidence families, it does not claim to recreate checked-in source deliverables, and it does not self-certify route-proof evidence that was absent before the terminal step.
